title: Post-100 depth batch 09
notes: Bounded depth batch under Issue #261. Adds first-party-backed release history for MEW Mobile, imToken App and Solflare Browser Extension. MEW's first-party retrospective establishes the full-fledged mobile wallet release in March 2020; imToken's first-party milestone history establishes version 1.0 release on 2016-11-11; Solflare first-party documentation establishes the Web App and Extension product lineage in late 2020. Canonical publication is prohibited until candidate validation/review and a fresh exact-main promotion complete.

events.title: Full-fledged MEW wallet mobile app released
events.description: MyEtherWallet's first-party ten-year retrospective states that its full-fledged MEW wallet app was released in March 2020 after the earlier MEWconnect signer-app lineage.
events.notes: Month precision only. The reviewed first-party retrospective establishes March 2020 but not one defensible exact release day. If promoted, wlr_prod_000076 can be corrected from unresolved launch_date to 2020-03 with month precision. This is the full-fledged MEW wallet app, not the earlier MEWconnect signer app.

events.title: imToken version 1.0 released
events.description: imToken's first-party milestone history states that after the project was established on 2016-05-02, imToken version 1.0 was released on 2016-11-11.
events.notes: This is the selected app release milestone and is intentionally distinct from the entity founding date. If promoted, wlr_prod_000078 can be corrected from unresolved launch_date to 2016-11-11 with day precision. Existing 2018 imToken 2.0 Beta incident history remains separate.

events.title: Solflare Web App and Extension launched in 2020
events.description: Solflare's first-party documentation states that the Web App and Extension were the first products built by the team in late 2020 and establishes the browser-extension product lineage during that year.
events.notes: Year precision only. The reviewed first-party documentation does not establish one defensible exact public-release month or day, so the existing 2020 launch_date and year precision remain unchanged.

evidence.title: 10 Years of MyEtherWallet: Evolving with Ethereum
evidence.notes: First-party MEW retrospective states that the full-fledged MEW wallet app was released in March 2020 and distinguishes it from the earlier MEWconnect signer app. Used at month precision only.

evidence.title: Progress Update | 2023/06/14
evidence.notes: First-party imToken milestone history states the project was established on 2016-05-02 and version 1.0 was released on 2016-11-11. Used for the app release event and proposed canonical launch-date correction.

evidence.title: Web App & Extension | Solflare Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party Solflare documentation states the Web App and Extension were the first products built by the team in late 2020. Used at year precision only.
